teaser.oneParentPays: One subscription for the whole household: one parent pays, both get access.
teaser.expenses.title: Who owes what? Stop keeping score.
teaser.expenses.lede: Each parent logs what they pay for the kids. Alternly applies your split and keeps the balance up to date, no spreadsheet, no reminder texts.
teaser.expenses.p1: School lunches, health, activities: log each expense in seconds, with each parent's share.
teaser.expenses.p2: A clear balance between both parents, always up to date.
teaser.expenses.p3: A reimbursement request as PDF, even if your co-parent doesn't use Alternly.
teaser.expenses.p4: Disputes and reimbursements on record: no more “I already paid you”.
teaser.wall.title: Everything about the kids, in one place.
teaser.wall.lede: Notes, tasks and questions between parents, without burying them in texts. Due dates show up on the calendar.
teaser.wall.p1: Tasks to check off, with a due date and an owner.
teaser.wall.p2: Questions waiting for an answer, easy to spot.
teaser.wall.p3: A calm, factual thread both parents can read.
teaser.wall.demo1: Return the field trip permission slip
teaser.wall.demo2: Who takes Leo to the dentist?
teaser.journal.title: Write down the facts. Export them when you need to.
teaser.journal.lede: A private custody journal: handovers, delays, changes, health, school. Each note is dated and time-stamped when you write it.
teaser.journal.p1: Private: your co-parent never sees it.
teaser.journal.p3: Matched with the calendar: who was scheduled to have the kids.
teaser.journal.p4: Exportable as PDF for your lawyer or a mediator.
teaser.journal.demo1Sub: Handover planned at 6 pm, kids picked up at 6:40 pm.
teaser.journal.demo2Sub: Pediatrician: ear infection, antibiotics for 7 days.
teaser.pension.title: Child support, tracked month by month.
teaser.pension.lede: Log the payments you receive and see at a glance what's still owed. Alternly works out the yearly revaluation and reminds you.
teaser.pension.p1: Each month marked paid, partial, not received or upcoming.
teaser.pension.p2: The amount still owed, calculated for you.
teaser.pension.p3: The yearly revaluation per your order's index, with a reminder.
